name: codex-checkpoint
description: Codex task memory plugin: preserve user constraints, decisions, failed attempts and checkpoints to resume coding tasks.

interface.longDescription: Save task progress, user constraints, decision reasons and failed attempts in local Git projects. Resume with repository state checks and lifecycle history. Requires Python 3.10+ and Git. Assistant-driven recording; no background capture, lossless memory or measured efficiency claims.
defaultPrompt: Maintain constraints, decisions and failed attempts during this task.
Read the checkpoint and continue this task.

prompts: Maintain user constraints, decisions and failed attempts during this task.
Read my checkpoint and continue this task.
review.commerce_description: Free plugin. No purchases or payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial public submission candidate with local snapshots and structured task records.
